propertySets.name: Pset_MechanicalFastenerTypeRailFastening
propertySets.definition: Properties of rail fastening used in railway track system. The property set can be used by the predefined type RAILFASTENING of IfcMechanicalFastener.

properties.name: TechnicalStandard
properties.definition: The technical standard which the element should comply with.

properties.name: IsReducedResistanceFastening
properties.definition: Indicates whether the rail fastening is a reduced resistance fastening (YES) or not (NO).
